title: Ganeshapal Giri v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Manoj Kumar Gupta, J. and Ajit Singh, J.
disposition: Petition disposed of; relegated to section 127 appeal.
headnote: The petitioner challenged a 19 September 2022 communication, held to be the electricity department's order on his clause 6.5 representation pursuant to an earlier High Court direction, not a mere notice. Department counsel produced a final assessment dated 9 December 2020 treating the 26 October 2020 provisional assessment as final for want of objection. The Division Bench declined to examine the assessment or the rejected letting-out plea in writ jurisdiction and disposed of the petition, leaving the petitioner to the statutory appeal under section 127 of the Electricity Act, 2003.
facts: Ganeshapal Giri challenged a 19 September 2022 communication of the electricity department. It was the order on his clause 6.5 representation, filed under liberty granted in Writ-C No. 10151 of 2022. Counsel for the department produced a final assessment dated 9 December 2020 recording that no objection had been filed to the provisional assessment of 26 October 2020. The representation was rejected on a letting-out plea for want of a registered lease; counsel admitted only an unregistered photocopy of an agreement existed.

holding_units.topic: statutory appeal against final assessment; writ declined
holding_units.holding: Where a final assessment order is on record (provisional assessment treated as final for want of objection) and the consumer's clause 6.5 representation has already been rejected, the High Court will not examine the assessment in writ jurisdiction and will leave the consumer to the statutory appeal under section 127 of the Electricity Act, 2003.

principle_tags.application: The 9 December 2020 final assessment (provisional of 26 October 2020 treated as final for want of objection) was left to section 127 appeal; the writ was not entertained on the merits.
The Court declined writ examination and expressly left the petitioner to the statutory remedy of appeal under section 127.

not_decided.point: Correctness of the final assessment and the letting-out/lease plea
not_decided.note: Writ examination declined; petitioner left to section 127 appeal.
